source_contract: Literal Real.exp(q) for q:Rat<=0; original Hermite left/right tails use q=p and q=-p. No replacement of source interpolant or normalization.

definitions.poly: poly(q:Rat,n:Nat):Rat = sum i in range(n+1), q^i / i!
definitions.bounds: bounds(q:Rat,T n:Nat):Rat*Rat = if q<=-(T:Rat) then (0,tailRadius T) else (poly q n-radius q n,poly q n+radius q n)
definitions.checked: checked(q epsilon:Rat,T n:Nat):Option(Rat*Rat) = some(bounds q T n) exactly if q<=0,epsilon>0 and width<=epsilon; otherwise none

signatures: error(q:Rat,n:Nat)(hq:q<=0): abs(Real.exp(q:Real)-(poly q n:Real)) <= (radius q n:Real)
membership(q:Rat,T n:Nat)(hq:q<=0): Real.exp(q:Real) in Set.Icc ((bounds q T n).1:Real) ((bounds q T n).2:Real)
checked_sound(q epsilon:Rat,T n:Nat,I:Rat*Rat)(h:checked q epsilon T n=some I): 0<epsilon and Real.exp(q:Real) in Set.Icc (I.1:Real)(I.2:Real) and I.2-I.1<=epsilon
binder_audit: q<=0 is the literal scalar domain. T/n are finite producer choices. No exp interval, derivative estimate, source Lipschitz or desired certificate is assumed.
resource_boundary: The clipped branch avoids evaluating powers of arbitrarily huge |q|; input parsing/comparison remains charged. No uniform degree-cap, allocation/completeness, Python refinement or total bit/runtime theorem is asserted.

exp(1)>=2 + exp natural multiple + inverse monotonicity
